text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! How about some special chocolate 
for that special someone?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At a special Valentine's event venue in a 
department store, Ines Fujin was hard at 
work at her temporary part-time job.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, this chocolate looks gorgeous han! 
It's super chic and stylish, I bet...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yep, you've got a great eye, Yuki-chan! 
This chocolate is super popular in fashion 
magazines right now!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Here's my recommendation for City-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ines-san!? H-How did you know it was for 
City-san...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, because it's just so perfect for 
you, City-chan! Simple and glossy dark 
chocolate♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, b-but... um... Would someone like me 
giving it even matter...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
City-san will probably get a crazy amount 
of Valentine's chocolates this year too, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Wouldn't that be a bother...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way! There's simply no way that 
could happen.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You're putting so much thought into 
picking it out just for them, Yuki-chan. 
I'm sure they'll love it!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, okay? Let's make sure Yuki-chan's 
feelings reach City-chan!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...My feelings... ...I want them to 
reach... City...!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ines-san, I'd like this chocolate, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a Valentine's limited flavor? That 
looks delicious... I'll take this one.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...No, maybe a limited-edition item is a 
bit too heavy? If I make them feel 
unnecessarily obligated and they end up 
turning it down, what will I do...?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Then how about buying one for yourself 
too? If you invite her to eat together, 
I'm sure she'll accept!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Tea time for just the two of us in our 
dorm room. Our conversation is bound to be 
so lively!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
! That sounds wonderful! Fufu, if I could 
savor it together with Ikuno-san—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...U-Um... *Ahem*. I shall have two of the 
limited-edition chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Please give me chocolate that Milady will 
accept!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hrrrrrmmm...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
How about chocolates from a heritage brand 
purveyed by the "Splendid Clan" itself!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Purveyor to the rich? For now, it gives 
total Ojousama Groove, so let's go with 
that!!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Man, you really saved my bacon! Huge 
thanks!! So go ahead and order as much 
extra as you want! It's on my tab anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If Ines hadn't been there, I would've 
picked some weird chocolate and crashed 
and burned!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm totally used to this kind of 
consultation! Whenever I see someone 
agonizing over the person they like, I 
just can't help but meddle~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, so pro☆ Btw, Ines, what kind of 
chocolate are you giving your crush? What 
kind of pro chocolate is it, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? "Sukipi"...?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You're giving chocolate too, right, 
Ines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, as for me... Ah! I'm thinking 
about what chocolates to give everyone! I 
was thinking of making mini brownies.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
That's just friendship chocolate! Not 
that, the re-al dea-l☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hup... Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um... N-Nothing like that, really... 
L-Like a crush or whatever...? I don't 
have one..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? But that choco sundae was 
legendary!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Well then, what about a crush? Don't you 
have anyone you're crushing on?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Ooh!? Is there an opening there? Is 
there...!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, it's totally not like that! Not 
at all, okay?!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Break time is over! Well, I'm heading 
back! See you later!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! Happy V-Day☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...If that kind of person ever comes 
along—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know if this counts as a 
candidate, but—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, as a token of my daily gratitude, 
I suppose? Maybe I'll give you some 
chocolate~...
